nodes.name: basic.json
nodes.summary: Defines the field-name schema for the 'basic' neural network I/O modality, listing named channels for vehicle state (current pose/velocity/orientation), control command, physical parameters, wrench, resultant force/torque, and placeholder slots for feature vectors and class tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: Each top-level key maps to a list of per-dimension labels (or null placeholders for unnamed tensor dimensions like feature_vector/class_token), used to auto-generate normalization and indexing logic for network inputs/outputs.

nodes.name: image.json
nodes.summary: Defines the field-name schema for the 'image' neural network I/O modality, specifying spatial (null) dimensions plus named channel labels for rgb_image, depth_image, feature_array, and patches tensors.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses null entries to represent unlabeled spatial (height/width) dimensions of image-like tensors, with only the channel dimension explicitly named (e.g. r/g/b, d).

nodes.name: sequence.json
nodes.summary: Defines the field-name schema for the 'sequence' neural network I/O modality, describing time-series inputs/outputs such as dynamics (dt, pose, velocity, orientation, thrust/torque command), wrenches, feature_arrays, and fo_horizon (flat-output horizon) trajectories.
nodes.languageNotes: Each key's outer null entry represents the time-step dimension, followed by the named per-timestep feature labels, consistent with sequence-model (e.g. transformer/RNN) input framing.
